special_traits.description:
While in a 10-foot Emanation origi-
nating from the hobgoblin, the hobgoblin and its allies have Advantage on attack rolls and saving throws, provided the hobgoblin doesn't have the Incapacitated condition.

Greatsword or Longbow in any combination.
